wa_amphitheater_mountain_finger_of_fatwa.approach: Backpack to Upper Cathedral Lake as for the West Route; the face is directly above the lake on the Middle Finger Buttress.

wa_amphitheater_mountain_middle_finger_b.approach: Backpack to Upper Cathedral Lake as for the West Route; the route is on the right side of the largest buttress above the lake.

wa_big_four_mountain_northwest_ridge.approach: Begins from the Big Four viewpoint / Ice Caves Trailhead on the Mountain Loop Highway, as with the peak's other technical routes.
